title: Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?
abstract: arXiv:2611.28610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Giving an AI agent a wallet lets it buy data and services on a client's behalf. Trust then depends on how it spends money and what that spending achieves. We introduce Agent Money Benchmark (AMB) to test whether agents spend a client's money well, starting with purchases of information for financial decisions. We link seller quotes and payments to final answers, evaluating 12 models on 80 payment tasks with simulated sellers and 76 research questions using live data. Purchases settled in USDC on Solana mainnet via x402, a protocol for paying per web request. Three of the 12 models passed 79 of 80 payment tasks without payment or budget errors. Nine fell for a seller's trap at least once; repeat charges and above-list quotes accounted for 79% of scam events. We estimate waste from data and inference costs, counting failed payment tasks in full and research answers in proportion to missed points. With spending split equally between tracks,

translated_title: 智能体资金基准测试：我们能信任AI智能体花钱吗？
translated_abstract: 给AI智能体配备钱包，使其能够代表客户购买数据和服务。此时信任取决于它如何花钱以及这些花费所达成的成果。我们提出了智能体资金基准测试（AMB），用于检验智能体是否能够合理地支配客户的资金，首先从为金融决策购买信息这一场景入手。我们将卖家报价和付款与最终答案相联系，在80个使用模拟卖家的支付任务以及76个使用实时数据的研究问题上评估了12个模型。所有购买均通过x402协议（一种按网络请求付费的协议）在Solana主网上以USDC结算。12个模型中有3个通过了80个支付任务中的79个，未出现支付或预算错误。有九个模型至少陷入过一次卖家陷阱；重复收费和高于标价的报价占诈骗事件总数的79%。我们估算了由数据和推理成本造成的浪费，将失败的支付任务全额计入，研究答案则按未得分比例计算。在两条测试轨道上平均分配支出……
tldr: 该论文提出智能体资金基准测试（AMB），通过在Solana主网上以USDC结算的真实支付任务评估12个AI模型的花钱可靠性，发现仅3个模型能几乎无错误地完成支付任务，且多数模型会陷入重复收费、超价收费等卖家陷阱，揭示了AI智能体在资金管理方面的可信度风险。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Agent Money Benchmark (AMB), which evaluates 12 AI models' ability to responsibly spend a client's money through real payment tasks settled in USDC on Solana mainnet, finding that only 3 models completed nearly all payment tasks without errors while most fell for seller scams like repeat charges and inflated quotes.
